_comment: One entry per tenant that has had real design attention (not just onboarding defaults). Append, never overwrite -- the point is to prove the archetype/palette/display axes actually vary across tenants over time. See SKILL.md 'Structure must vary, not just colour'.

tenants.archetype: portrait-led: gallery immediately after hero, before services and about
tenants.displayStrategy: weight contrast (one face, Estedad, extrabold hero vs normal/medium body)
tenants.brandColorSource: sampled from the tenant's own Instagram profile photo, not chosen from a palette
tenants.notes: First tenant to move off the original night-gold/light-editorial/bold-modern set. Built because his business is Instagram-led (~8k followers) so proof-of-work photography needed to lead, not sit mid-page. See apps/web/src/themes/tenant-directions/reza-hosseini.md for the full brief and rationale.
